title: Inventory Buttons
description: Brings the "Inventory Buttons" feature from NotEnoughUpdates (NEU) to modern versions of Minecraft (26.1 / 1.21.11 / 1.21.5)
body:
# Inventory Buttons (Unofficial Port)

A Fabric mod that brings the popular "Inventory Buttons" feature from [NotEnoughUpdates (NEU)](https://modrinth.com/mod/notenoughupdates) to modern version of Minecraft.

**Current Versions Supported**: 1.21.11, 26.1

Deprecated version on 1.21.5

_This mod requires Fabric API_

## Features

* **Inventory Buttons:** Add customizable buttons to your inventory for quick commands.
  > -> Create customizable buttons to run any command
* **Editor Mode:** Easily move and configure buttons to suit your playstyle. 
  > -> Add custom skulls or use any Vanilla item as your button icon.
  > 
  > -> Move the button on a grid with snapping or anywhere without snapping
* **Profiles:** Save button layouts in profiles. 
  > -> Export layouts to share or save. Import them via clipboard.
  >
  > -> Switch between profiles with the built in command or in the config menu.
  >
  > -> In the Profile menu (access through main config), type to save 

## Mod Commands
`/invbuttons` or `/inventorybuttons`: open the mod's main config. At the moment, there are just a few qol settings:
> * Turn Inventory Buttons off entirely
> * Show Tooltips on buttons (your commands)
> * Hide buttons in Creative Mode
> * Grid Snap defaults to on each time you enter the edit menu or not (otherwise, it keeps your last used setting)

`/invbuttons edit`: access the button editor via command

`/invbuttons profile <name>`: switch between button profiles by simply listing the name (compatible with buttons!)

`/invbuttons help`: display all of these commands and usages

## Bugs and Issues
Please report bugs and issues to the mod's GitHub issues page [here](https://github.com/afranz29/Inventory-Buttons/issues) (also accessible on the right hand side of the Modrinth page)
